data.title: Nanjing Leads Biolabs Enrolls First Patient in Confirmatory Phase III EP-NEC Study
data.description:
The latest announcement is out from Nanjing Leads Biolabs Co., Ltd. Class H ( (HK:9887) ).

Nanjing Leads Biolabs develops innovative biological products, including LBL-024 (opamtistomig), an anti-PD-L1/4-1BB bispecific antibody, for cancer treatment. Its clinical work described here also covers SCLC, BTC, HCC and ovarian cancer.

On Nov. 27, 2026, the first patient was enrolled in a confirmatory, randomized, double-blind, multicenter Phase III study of LBL-024 plus platinum-based chemotherapy as first-line treatment for advanced EP-NEC; overall survival is the primary endpoint. The LBL-024 monotherapy NDA for advanced EP-NEC had been accepted by China’s NMPA and included in its priority review and approval procedure, while company-reported studies cited median OS of 8.7 months in later-line EP-NEC and an 18-month OS rate of 55.7% in first-line EP-NEC combination treatment.

data.title: Bepirovirsen Approved in China as First-in-Class Functional Cure for CHB
data.description:
Sino Biopharmaceutical ( (HK:1177) ) has issued an announcement.

Sino Biopharmaceutical, a biopharmaceutical company, announced that China’s NMPA approved bepirovirsen (Hibsago) for marketing as a first-in-class functional cure for chronic hepatitis B. It is approved with nucleos(t)ide analogue therapy for non-cirrhotic adults who have received that therapy for at least six months, with HBV DNA below 90 IU/mL and HBsAg at or below 3,000 IU/mL.

Approval followed pooled B-Well phase III results: six-month treatment produced a 19% functional-cure rate, or 233 of 1,220 participants, versus zero of 614 receiving placebo. The rate was 26% in participants with HBsAg at or below 1,000 IU/mL, while Chinese subgroup rates ranged from 24% to 61% across HBsAg thresholds; reported adverse events included injection-site erythema, local pain and temporary liver-enzyme increases.

Chronic hepatitis B affects more than 240 million people globally, including approximately 75 million people in China, and contributed to an estimated 450,000 deaths in China in 2023. The release notes that many patients require lifelong antiviral therapy and that functional cure is associated with reduced risk of long-term complications, including liver cancer.

data.title: Chinney Investments Reports Higher Revenue Amid Property Valuation Pressure
data.description:
The latest announcement is out from Chinney Investments, Limited ( (HK:0216) ).

For the six months ended 30 September 2026, Chinney Investments’ investment and rental property business in Hong Kong and the Chinese Mainland reported revenue of HK$577 million, up 29% from HK$447 million, while underlying profit fell 16% to HK$190 million from HK$227 million. Its Mainland rental properties are in Tier 1 cities and recorded higher occupancy and rents, while recurring income increased.

Investment property write-downs totaled HK$258 million, though the non-cash charge was smaller than in the same period last year and did not affect core operating profit. The company said Hong Kong and Mainland property markets remained under pressure, and the Board recommended no interim dividend, as in 2025.
